held_out_validation_policy: These four countries were excluded from calibration fitting. Their FIFA 2023 ranking observations remain validation-only and never appear in rating provenance.
method: Canonical authoring from structural history, Big Count 2006 and FIFA Professional 2023 where available, with low-confidence historical backcasts and deterministic annual interpolation.
evidence_rules: No held-out FIFA ranking observation may be referenced by a country rating.
Big Count primarily informs popularity/access and is population-context evidence, not a universal strength score.
Professional 2023 player/club counts inform competition and elite ecosystem context, not development or direct support quality by themselves.
San Marino's missing professional-report fields remain missing and are never converted to zero.
Germany before 1991 explicitly under-covers the former GDR rather than inventing a full current-territory history.
Small population is not penalised in access; Iceland and San Marino can have very high access with materially lower competition depth.

country_notes.BRA: World-leading football environment with very high popularity/tradition and strong competition/development, but access remains below the densest European microstate systems.
country_notes.DEU: Near-world-leading access, tradition, development and elite support; pre-reunification evidence is explicitly partial-current-territory.
country_notes.ISL: High participation/access and strong small-country pathways, with competition depth bounded by population scale.
country_notes.SMR: High local access/tradition and long institutional continuity, but shallow competition depth; professional-report absence is treated as unknown.
